examples.name: Simple Validation
examples.vap:
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "force-ha-in-prod"
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:   ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations:  ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources:   ["deployments"]
  validations:
    - expression: "object.spec.replicas >= 3"
      message: "All production deployments should be HA with at least three replicas"
examples.dataObject:

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    app: kubernetes-bootcamp
  name: kubernetes-bootcamp

examples.name: Variables in Validation
examples.vap:
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "image-matches-namespace-environment.policy.example.com"
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:   ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations:  ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources:   ["deployments"]
  variables:
  - name: environment
    expression: "'environment' in namespaceObject.metadata.labels ? namespaceObject.metadata.labels['environment'] : 'prod'"
  - name: exempt
    expression: "'exempt' in object.metadata.labels && object.metadata.labels['exempt'] == true"
  - name: containers
    expression: "object.spec.template.spec.containers"
  - name: containersToCheck
    expression: "variables.containers.filter(c, c.image.contains('example.com/'))"
  validations:
  - expression: "variables.exempt || variables.containersToCheck.all(c, c.image.startsWith(variables.environment + '.'))"
    messageExpression: "'only ' + variables.environment + ' images are allowed in namespace ' + namespaceObject.metadata.name"

examples.name: Match Conditions
examples.vap:
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "demo-policy.example.com"
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
      - apiGroups:   ["*"]
        apiVersions: ["*"]
        operations:  ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
        resources:   ["*"]
  matchConditions:
    - name: 'exclude-leases' # Each match condition must have a unique name
      expression: '!(request.resource.group == "coordination.k8s.io" && request.resource.resource == "leases")' # Match non-lease resources.
    - name: 'exclude-kubelet-requests'
      expression: '!("system:nodes" in request.userInfo.groups)' # Match requests made by non-node users.
  validations:
    - expression: "!object.metadata.name.contains('demo') || object.metadata.namespace == 'demo'"

examples.name: CEL Libraries
examples.vap:
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "cel-libraries"
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:   ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations:  ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources:   ["deployments"]
  variables:
    - name: image
      expression: "object.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image"
    - name: tag
      expression: "variables.image.split(':')[1]"
  validations:
    # semver (1.33+): require a released image tag, not a pre-release.
    - expression: "isSemver(variables.tag, true) && semver(variables.tag, true).isGreaterThan(semver('v1.0.0', true))"
      message: "the image tag must be a semver greater than v1.0.0"
    # format (1.31+): the name must be a valid DNS label. validate()
    # returns the errors as an optional, empty when the value is valid.
    - expression: "!format.dns1123Label().validate(object.metadata.name).hasValue()"
      message: "metadata.name must be a valid DNS1123 label"

examples.name: Authorizer
examples.vap:
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "restrict-privileged-deployments"
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:   ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations:  ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources:   ["deployments"]
  validations:
    # Only somebody the cluster would let run the "escalate" verb on
    # deployments may create a privileged one. The verb does not have to
    # be one the API itself serves -- a rule may name any verb, which is
    # how a policy asks a question only it cares about.
    - expression: >-
        !object.spec.template.spec.containers.exists(c,
          has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.privileged) && c.securityContext.privileged)
        || authorizer.group("apps").resource("deployments")
             .namespace(object.metadata.namespace).check("escalate").allowed()
      message: "privileged containers may only be deployed by someone authorized to escalate deployments"

# Real RBAC objects, resolved by Kubernetes' own RBAC authorizer. Change
# the binding's subject to someone other than alice, or delete it, and the
# validation fails.
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: deployment-escalator
  namespace: default
rules:
  - apiGroups: ["apps"]
    resources: ["deployments"]
    verbs: ["escalate"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: alice-deployment-escalator
  namespace: default
subjects:
  - kind: User
    apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
    name: alice
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: deployment-escalator
